work.title: Untitled (CD Altar Assembly)
work.description: Dense, vertically oriented mixed-media collage incorporates multiple compact discs, red geometric shapes, plastic spoons, candles, and scattered confetti-like debris arranged in a roughly symmetrical composition. Iridescent CD surfaces dominate the upper and middle registers, while white plastic spoons and candles line the lower edge.
work.composition: vertical symmetrical arrangement with layered CD clusters
